summary: Full backend + frontend test of Power Dialer & GoHighLevel integration. Backend: 5/5 existing pytest unit tests pass (tests/test_power_dialer.py). Wrote a new API-level regression suite (tests/test_power_dialer_api.py, 16 tests) exercising the deployed preview URL — all 16 pass. Frontend: logged in as forest, navigated in-app via history.pushState+popstate to /dialer, /dialer/campaign/{id}, /dialer/dnc, /admin/ghl, /admin/test-lab. Every data-testid the review requested is present and functional (dialer-header, dialer-rules toggle with state rules table, dnc/ghl link tiles, seeded 'QA Demo: Utah dealers' campaign card, +new-campaign sheet with all chips + save, campaign stats tiles, log tab with 5 attempts including ABANDONED row, campaign-throttled banner, dnc registry card/stats/phone/check/add, ghl status/location-id/token/save/source-none, lab feature card + dialer-lab-{open,dnc,ghl}). NEVER triggered campaign-start / POST /api/dialer/sessions (per safety rules).
